highlights: Manufacturer quote page explicitly offers the Buddy PRO + multi-application package
TeleBuddy and MyBuddyApp support remote classroom attendance and video interaction from a phone or tablet
Programming SDK access, training and docking equipment are separately listed options

The technical sheets and guide table give a 560 mm platform height, while the current Buddy overview says 60 cm. This source difference remains unresolved; the PRO+ offer does not identify a hardware revision that reconciles it.

The Buddy platform guide rates endurance up to 6 h depending on use and specifies forward 70 cm/s versus backward 35 cm/s. Those scoped platform figures are not battery charging time or guaranteed ratings for every PRO+ revision.

The guide says remote piloting disables obstacle detection because the operator controls stopping. Cliff-sensor behavior and blind spots retain their limits; this is not a promise of collision-free or fail-safe navigation.

Optional self-parking requires a fixed charging station and visual proximity. Education/developer packs, apps, SDK subscriptions and accessories do not establish additional robot chassis; the old one-month EU quote template is not a current retail offer.

highlights: Buddy is offered across education, inclusion, senior interaction and reception. PRO+ is a multi-application package; education and developer packs, applications and customized deployments do not independently identify new chassis models.

The Android SDK supports custom applications, while TeleBuddy on the robot pairs with MyBuddyApp on a phone/tablet for remote video interaction. Service subscriptions, SDK access, training and docking equipment retain their stated offer scopes.

Expressive screen/head behavior and touch/voice interaction are product-design features. Manufacturer therapeutic and emotional-benefit language, testimonials, awards and deployment totals are not independent proof of clinical efficacy, sentience, emergency monitoring or universal application safety.
